rows.transcript_1:
Managing anger can be really difficult. Take a break when you feel you are getting angry at your children or someone else.

Go somewhere else for 5 minutes to regain control of your emotions. If you have a safe outdoor space, go outside. You can get through this!
rows.transcript_2:
Menguruskan rasa marah memang tidak mudah. Bila anda mula rasa marah kepada anak‑anak atau sesiapa sahaja, cuba berhenti seketika.

Pergilah ke tempat lain selama 5 minit untuk menenangkan diri dan mengawal emosi anda. Jika ada ruang luar yang selamat, keluar sebentar.

Anda pasti mampu melalui saat ini!
rows.title: Angry? Take a break

text_1_facilitator.eng:
Welcome back! Today’s skill is about how you and your spouse can set an example for your children by creating respect at home. 💙 

Family and friends might have their own ideas about how you should act as a spouse or a parent.❗

But what matters most is how both husband and wife choose to talk to and support each other, and make decisions together and respectfully. 🔄

text_2.eng: Treating each other with respect and making decisions together can have a big impact on how you feel and can help keep your child feel safe. 💚😃

text_1_facilitator.eng: 4️⃣ Here are four simple steps that you and your spouse can use to create respect at home for your children to learn from:

rows.text_1_facilitator: 4️⃣ Here are four simple steps that you and your spouse can use to create respect at home for your children to learn from:

section_1_text.eng:
💡 Involve your spouse in decision making processes.
💙 Try this the next time you are making a decision.

section_2_text.eng:
😃 It can be hard to know how to involve your spouse when making a decision. 
✨ You can try by asking them what they think. 
💚 This shows them you care and want them to be involved.

section_3_text.eng: ⏰ Choose a time when you and your spouse are not too busy to discuss decisions, such as early in the morning or later in the evening.

section_4_text.eng:
⏰ It can take time to get used to making decisions together. 
🔄 Give yourself time and keep trying! 
😃 By communicating with your spouse, you’ll both feel more comfortable talking and sharing decisions over time.
